subject: Request: weekend P1/P2 on-call pooling & vendor escalation path for FastLedger integration
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@fastledger.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Ops <procure@fastledger.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Weekend stress run — request to modify P1/P2 coverage

Hi Rishi,

Quick note — FastLedger has scheduled a full-stack integration stress test this Saturday (10/17) from 00:00–06:00 UTC to validate our failover behavior with Redwood. We expect a spike in live traffic for short bursts and want to avoid a misrouted P1 during the window.

Two asks: 
1) Can Redwood temporarily pool regional on-call routing so our US traffic during the window is handled by a hotseat that can escalate directly to FastLedger engineering (we'll provide 24/7 contact).
2) We need an explicit escalation path documented (who gets paged at each step) and a single contact for Rapid Response so the on-call engineer can hand off fast.

This is a tight timeline — can we get confirmation and an escalation matrix by EOD tomorrow? We can sign a short amendment if needed.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Integrations, FastLedger
Attachment: requirements_summary.pdf (PDF summary provided to Redwood)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fastledger.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend stress run — request to modify P1/P2 coverage

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the draft requirements. We can support a temporary routing carve-in for the window, but need to confirm two operational details before we lock anything in:

- Scope: Is the traffic spike limited to your US region (I see mixed traffic) or should we treat it as multi-region?
- Escalation SLA: do you want direct escalation from our P1 page to your on-call first, or a parallel escalation (Redwood ops -> Redwood SRE -> FastLedger eng)? Direct escalation is faster but requires waiving our normal vendor-only escalation model.

Proposed interim plan (we can formalize in a short amendment):
- Hotseat model: Redwood assigns one named hotseat (US-based) for the 6-hour window to receive P1/P2 pages.
- Direct paging: For P1 only, hotseat will page FastLedger primary contact (Elena / Jared) immediately; Redwood SRE is second-level.
- For P2, Redwood will follow standard routing (Redwood on-call -> Redwood SRE; we will notify FastLedger via Slack and email if an incident escalates).

Soojin — can you prepare a simple escalation matrix and runbook patch we can attach (contain exact paging numbers, Slack handles, and the postmortem owner)? Ben — can you confirm short-term credits and whether procurement needs a PO/amendment?

If that plan looks ok to FastLedger we'll deploy config changes and test PagerDuty routing tonight in staging.

—Rishi
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@fastledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend stress run — request to modify P1/P2 coverage

Hi team — draft matrix attached. Key points included:

- Hotseat: Rishi (hotseat ID: RDW-US-HOT-01) for 00:00–06:00 UTC on 2026-10-17.
- P1 flow: RDW-US-HOT-01 pages FastLedger primary (Elena / Jared) via direct PagerDuty escalation; if no ack in 5 minutes, Redwood SRE (soojin_lee) and then on-call manager (ben_carter) are paged.
- P2 flow: RDW-US-HOT-01 -> Redwood SRE; FastLedger notified via Slack channel #fastledger-integration (no page).
- Contact details: included phone numbers and PD escalation keys.
- Post-incident: FastLedger will own postmortem for any integration-caused failures; Redwood will own runtime/post-sla analysis.

Attachment: fastledger_temp_escalation_matrix.pdf

I'll push the PagerDuty temporary policy and a one-off routing rule tonight to staging; please confirm the phone numbers in the PDF.

Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@fastledger.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend stress run — request to modify P1/P2 coverage

Elena — we can approve a temporary routing amendment and issue a credit for any minutes lost to misrouting during the window (covered under FL-INTG-temp credit). Procurement: we'll use a short amendment (DocuSign link below) to add a one-week carve-in that covers direct P1 paging to FastLedger. No PO required for the credit; attach the signed amendment and we'll finalize.

I attached the draft mutual action plan spreadsheet with the amendment text and the billing credit line.

Attachments: draft_map_weekend_oncall.xlsx
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena@fastledger.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Procure Ops <procure@fastledger.com>, Jared Lim <jared@fastledger.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend stress run — request to modify P1/P2 coverage

Thanks all — confirmed. We reviewed the matrix and phone numbers look good. Jared and I will sign the amendment when it lands in DocuSign; please include the Slack channel webhook for #fastledger-integration (we'll add PD escalation keys).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll run a staging smoke test tonight per Rishi's plan and escalate if anything behaves unexpectedly.

—Elena
